title: What's New — Auto Research & Clearer Fix Results
summary: PulseGuard can now research unresolved startup/service evidence automatically and explain grouped optimization warnings instead of leaving vague duplicate warnings.

items.heading: Automatic Research & Learning
items.detail: Unknown/REVIEW startup and service items are now checked against executable path, Authenticode publisher, installed-app ownership and learned local evidence. HIGH-confidence decisions are cached; uncertain items remain untouched.

items.heading: Safer Registry Research
items.detail: Stale compatibility entries can become backed-up SAFE-FIX items only when the target is missing and no installed app/package owns it. Live MSI/uninstall evidence is classified KEEP rather than left as an ambiguous warning.

items.heading: Optimization Warning Details
items.detail: Optimization process rows are clickable and show each underlying step, result, duration and exact warning/error. Multiple warnings display a count.

items.heading: Post-Fix Warning Reconciliation
items.detail: Locked browser cache files are reported as safe skips instead of generic failures, and registry repair no longer stays Warning when the final rescan shows zero SAFE-FIX items remaining.
